reviews.review_title: First Actual Great Minecraft Based Game
reviews.review_description: Gotta say this game is fantastic!  first of all, graphics are awesome, no doubt about that. The game is may be difficult to figure out at first (for me) but it's worth the experience once you get going. Gameplay is great too, menus look great and easy to use. Overall solid game 👍

developer_response.body: HI! we updated the game to include a tutorial for all keybinds! :)

reviews.review_description: This game is way better than any minecraft VR game . I actually can't believe they managed to create a minecraft based game AND MAKE IT BETTER . The combats mint , the gameplay is terrific and not to mention the flipping dimensions ! P.S this game saved me from getting rectal Spasms :))

I really enjoy the game, its just like Minecraft but just in vr. I do wish the days were longer and there was a cross hair to make it easier to break and place blocks. And if you add those, I would easily give it 5 starts. I wish the best for the game and the devs!

developer_response.body: HII, Thanks for ur review! we will be adding a crosshair and longer days :) we will let everyone know if we update the game !

reviews.review_title: the best minecraft style vr game OUT
reviews.review_description: This game quite literally feels like minecraft with its own little spin on it so it isnt a full on copy like realm craft and it just looks better. The music is great the sound effects are good the items and UI looks great it has very good multiplayer its gonna get free horror addons in the future (at the time of making this review) and its just overrall an amazing game

reviews.review_title: I Like The Game So Far
